content: {"paper_id":"W2003217181","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"subspace-clustering","exact_quote":"We propose a method based on sparse representation (SR) to cluster data drawn from multiple low-dimensional linear or affine subspaces embedded in a high-dimensional space.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"研究任务是对来自多个低维线性或仿射子空间的数据进行聚类/分割，符合子空间聚类定义。"},{"keyword_id":"sparse-representation","exact_quote":"Our method is based on the fact that each point in a union of subspaces has a SR with respect to a dictionary formed by all other data points.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"方案核心是学习并利用稀疏表示，将样本表示为其他数据点构成的字典下的稀疏组合。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","exact_quote":"The segmentation of the data is obtained by applying spectral clustering to a similarity matrix built from this SR.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"由稀疏表示构建样本间相似度/亲和矩阵并用于谱聚类，属于学习样本邻接/亲和结构。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"data-imputation-recovery","reason_zh":"摘要仅说方法可处理缺失数据，未说明估计缺失观测或恢复原始数值，无法判断是否符合数据补全与恢复的定义。"}],"input_issues":[]}
